newsitem.title: USA: Mirage Resorts Q4 shr $0.27 beats consensus.
newsitem.headline: Mirage Resorts Q4 shr $0.27 beats consensus.

text.p: Mirage Resorts Inc on Tuesday reported fourth quarter earnings of $0.27 per share, one cent above analysts' consensus estimate and 17 percent over the $0.23 per share in the year ago quarter.
Analysts had expected Mirage to earn between $0.21 and $0.29 a share in the quarter with the consensus being $0.26 a share, according to investment research firm First Call.
Net revenues, which exclude promotional expenses, fell slightly to $342.1 million from $343.5 milllion one year ago.
For 1996, Mirage earned $1.06 per share, well ahead of 1995's $0.85 a share, which included a $0.03 per share charge.
Net revenues for the year rose to $1.36 billion from $1.33 billion one year ago. Mirage shares ended up 1 to 24-3/4 in Tuesday trading before the earnings release.

The company's flagship hotel/casino, The Mirage, in Las Vegas posted operating cash flow, or earnings before depreciation, interest and taxes (EBDIT), of $63.2 million in the fourth quarter versus $59.1 million one year ago.

But Mirage's three other hotel casinos, Treasure Island, Golden Nugget and Golden Nugget-Laughlin, all saw operating cash flow decline in the fourth quarter, resulting in total EBDIT of $102 million versus $105 million last year.
